spiritgiven.comments: A lot of unnecessary contact that was at times dangerous and could have resolved in injuries. The communication was heated from time to time and players that weren't involved in the calls involved themselves fairly often even though your captain pointed out before the game, that you didn't want that. To add to this we felt that the some calls towards the end of the game when the score got tighter, the calls got more frequent and weren't consistent in comparison to the beginning.

The contact was very frequent and dangerous. We told you guys about it but we felt only a minor change. This resolved in us calling quite a few fouls upon which you almost always contested. The least spirited part of our game we feel was the sideline and the chants ("ils sont nuls") that you shouted which were often disrespectful and that do not belong in Ultimate Frisbee. The shocking and disappointing part is that it wasn't only your supporters or some individuals but the whole team.

spiritreceived.comments: great positive attitude, discussions took a long time
sometimes the layouts and ds against others’ momentums can be little bit dangerous. but overall a very spiritual game:)
Their players never seemed open to an opposing perspective. Although they always "listened", we got the impression that once a call was made they wouldn't change their point of view.

Thank you belgium for the game, we thought spirit was mostly decent the 1 in attitude was for some of the things said on the sideline that we found unspirited such as calling for “callaghans” but other than that it was a good game. Thank you!

Too many calls throughout the game, it’s okay to make calls you told us you were consistent with calling throughout the game, but some calls we’re unnecessary. The game flow was really jerky, not fun to watch and play. The communications were too long and spirit captains and game advisors met a lot of times and it didn’t seem to affect the way Belgium approached spirit. Unspirited reaction to the only call we made in this game.
Both team have a lot to learn from this game
Good communication between the matchups and on the field during calls. We liked that everyone respected the view of the other players and tried to solve the calls correct and quickly.
Brilliant game - genuinely don't understand how Belgium are so low in spirit, this wasn't far the most fun and well spirited game we've had this week. Congratulations on top 8 in the world :)
